question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 I 组：法国 vs 塞内加尔（2026-06-16）90 分钟赛果？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group I: France vs Senegal (2026-06-16) — 90-minute result?

one_liner_en: France's ~200-point Elo edge makes them clear favourites on form, but AFCON runners-up Senegal are in strong shape — draw plus upset tops 40%.

key_reasons.en: Elo gap of ~200 points (France 2063 vs Senegal 1860) at a neutral venue with no host bonus puts France's statistical baseline win probability near 59%.

key_reasons.en: Senegal are 2026 AFCON runners-up with Sadio Mane named player of the tournament — an experienced squad in strong form.
